title: Add shout.sh
body:
## Status
In progress.

## Problem
We want a third tool next to greet.sh and farewell.sh that shouts a text.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `bash shout.sh hi` prints `HI`.
- [ ] `bash shout.sh --times 3 hi` prints `HI` three times, one per line.
- [ ] `tests/shout.sh` covers it.

## Touches
shout.sh
tests/shout.sh
